Everything you need to ship from India to Paraguay or import from Paraguay to India: the trade agreement, routes and transit times, how your buyer imports, duties, regulators and documents.
India and Paraguay at a glance
India–Mercosur Preferential Trade Agreement (in force since 2009).
India exports motorcycles and parts, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, textiles and machinery. India buys soybean oil, soybeans and hides.
Routes and transit times to Paraguay
45–60 days. A landlocked country: ocean cargo discharges at Buenos Aires or Montevideo and moves up the Paraná river by barge, or by road from Brazilian ports (Paranaguá).
Transit times are indicative port-to-port from Nhava Sheva / Mundra (sea) and Delhi / Mumbai (air). Routing changes (for example Red Sea diversions) can add 10–14 days.
Importing into Paraguay: what your buyer needs
A licensed despachante de aduana files the import (SOFIA system).
Paraguay applies Mercosur exceptions with lower tariffs on many goods; its "tourism re-export" regime makes it a regional trading hub.
Mercosur TEC with many national exceptions (often lower), plus 10% VAT (IVA).

From Paraguay to India, and tips from the field
File the Bill of Entry through a licensed customs broker in India (YAM holds licence R-7/92).
Check the HS code in the Indian tariff, the DGFT import policy (free, restricted or prohibited) and any BIS, FSSAI, plant quarantine or other permit before the goods ship.
If an agreement applies, get the correct certificate of origin from the exporter to claim the lower duty.
Ask for through-transport rates to Asunción: river barge rates vary with water levels.
